  FAILED: 1 (Phase6PageOpsTest.DeleteLastPageIsNoOpOrErrorsCleanly)

Failure: EXPECT_NO_THROW caught a PdfeException("Cannot delete the
last page"). The production code throws a clean exception with a
descriptive message when DeletePageCommand is invoked on a
single-page document — which is the CORRECT behavior per the audit
row UI-PG-03 ("errors / no-ops"). The test was over-strict.

─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
FIX
─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

Test rewritten to:
- Catch the expected exception explicitly (looking for "last page"
  or "Cannot delete" in the message).
- Assert the page count remains at 1 regardless of which path the
  implementation took (throw or no-op).
- SUCCEED with metadata indicating which behavior was observed.

Production code unchanged. The contract was always met; the test had
the wrong expectation.
